Changes calendar delegation and declares no rollback. The pinned result has no data member; this method returns void under ordinary UAPI status handling.

Addresses retain their exact bytes and are form-encoded once in the POST body. No local address normalization, ownership or permission check is inferred. The pinned readonly default is 0 (full access), with 1 meaning read-only access. This is a documented default, not an observed server guarantee.

Omitting readonly, including explicit null, omits the field and can select source full access; explicitly choose true for read-only or false for full access when required. true sends 1 and false sends 0. No default is injected.
